items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know nobody but Dan -- Dan Andrews. See, when the band broke up, he came here. He didn't go nowhere.

ctx.x: He was gone, yeah. This was '34. So somebody came running in the place where he was in, and said, "Man, you'all's bus is on fire." We went out there, and man, the bus was about half burned up. Burned up Dan's bass, Debo's drums. Only thing it didn't burn up was the music. It saved that. And it didn't burn up... We had a big rack on the top of the bus where everybody had their handbags and their clothes and things like that. Some of them had taken them down. Didn't nobody's clothes get burned. While it was…
